Home.mascotDesc: A large welcoming area for the yellow ABJED Kids mascot to sit beside the hero message and make the page feel instantly playful and familiar.
Home.heroTitle: Master the Arabic Alphabet through Play!
Home.heroDesc: ABJED Kids helps children discover Arabic letters with joyful mini-games, kid-safe learning moments, and a parent-friendly experience built to support progress at every step.
Home.feature1Desc: Children learn each Arabic letter through engaging games that make education feel like pure fun.
Home.feature2Desc: Every lesson is ad-free, distraction-free, and locked behind our parent portal for maximum security.
Home.feature3Desc: Parents can monitor letter recognition and overall progress through simple, automated reports.

Login.heroTitle: Log in first to view subscription pricing
Login.heroDesc: To meet app store rules and keep purchases safely in adult hands, we ask parents to log in before reviewing plans. It is a quick parent-only step that keeps the experience secure and family-friendly.
Login.useParentAccount: Use your parent account to continue to subscription pricing.
Login.privacyDesc: We never sell your data, and we ensure the learning environment is 100% ad-free and COPPA compliant.

Signup.setupDesc: Setting up a parent account takes just a few seconds. Once registered, you can review subscription options and manage your child's learning journey securely.
Signup.privacyDesc: We never sell your data, and we ensure the learning environment is 100% ad-free and COPPA compliant.

Pricing.choosePlan: Choose the Right Plan for Your Child
Pricing.unlockAccess: Unlock full access to the Abjed Kids app.
Pricing.planCanceledDesc: Your subscription has been canceled and will not renew.
Pricing.secureCheckoutDesc: Your payment is processed securely. We don't store your credit card information.
Pricing.cancelAnytimeDesc: No long-term commitments. Easily cancel your subscription directly from this portal.
Pricing.explorerDesc: Access base daily activities and weekly learning quests.
Pricing.superDesc: Complete curriculum access with customized learning paths & zero distractions.
Pricing.ultimateDesc: Bring the whole family! Up to 4 sibling accounts with auto-sync profiles.
Pricing.faq1Question: Can I switch plans or cancel at any time?
Pricing.faq1Answer: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription directly from your Parent Portal with no cancellation fees.
Pricing.faq2Question: Are there any hidden in-app purchases?
Pricing.faq2Answer: Never. Once you subscribe to any of our plans, your children have absolute, unhindered access to all content, and you won't get hit with sneaky charges.
